No embroidery hoop, embroidery unit, digital screen, or embroidery-specific attachments are visible – the machine looks like a standard semi-industrial lockstitch machine.
Motor, foot pedal, and power cable are not visible in the frame (likely under the table, out of shot).
A watermark "POSTED ON JIJI – NANCY ANAEBO" overlays the image, consistent with a reused/stock marketplace photo.

Video of the machine powered on, stitching a sample seam, with audible motor sound.

response.reason: The nameplate visible in photo 0 contradicts the seller's stated brand and shows no embroidery features, so the item must be priced as an unverified, plain semi-industrial manual sewing machine at worst case (not proven working, no proven accessories, no proven embroidery function).
